title:
Your worlds.
Your rules.
sub:
Run multiple Valheim worlds.
Make each adventure your own.
caption: Run multiple Valheim worlds in one place, each with its own mods and settings.

title:
One container.
Your worlds.
sub:
Start with Docker and the setup wizard.
Create vanilla and modded worlds.
caption: One Docker container. A setup wizard. Multiple vanilla and modded Valheim worlds.

title:
One dashboard.
Every adventure.
sub:
Start, stop and update worlds separately.
Give each its own mods and settings.
caption: Manage multiple worlds from your browser: start, stop, update, settings and logs.

title:
Different worlds.
Different rules.
sub:
Vanilla or modded. Crossplay or Steam.
Choose passwords and public visibility.
caption: Choose vanilla or modded, crossplay, passwords, server listing and launch parameters for each world. Consoles cannot load mods.

title:
Your worlds.
Your schedule.
sub:
Set update windows and quiet periods.
Choose backup-first and timeout behaviour.
caption: Set each world’s update window, quiet period, timeout and backup-first policy. Player-aware updates require Companion telemetry.

title:
Find it.
Enable it.
sub:
Thunderstore. Hexium. Your local mods.
Search, select, pin a version—or follow latest.
caption: Select mods from Thunderstore, Hexium or Hugin's Vibes. Pin versions or follow the latest.

title:
Every mod.
Your settings.
sub:
Edit each world’s mod configs in-browser.
Keep saved overrides through updates.
caption: Edit mod settings in the browser. Saved overrides are reapplied when the world starts or updates.

title:
Your choices.
One shared pack.
sub:
Update the world to build its mod payload.
Dependencies and shared configs come along.
caption: Resolve dependencies and package each world’s mods and shared configurations for players. Server-only configs stay private.

title:
Pick a world.
Sync. Launch.
sub:
The PhValheim client downloads changes
before launching your modded game.
caption: Pick a world. The PhValheim client syncs mods and settings before launch. Vanilla worlds use ordinary Valheim.

title:
Back it up.
Stay in control.
sub:
Per-world backups, retention and access.
Your admins. Your players. Your rules.
caption: Choose per-world backup schedules and retention, manage access lists, admins and bans, and inspect logs.

title:
Have a mod idea?
Vibe it.
sub:
Ask Hugin for help. Build your own mods.
Publish locally. Try them on a test world.
caption: Ask Hugin for help. Build and package mods in Vibes; publish locally and try them on test worlds. AI optional.

title:
More worlds.
Less admin.
caption: More worlds. Less admin. Host, configure, mod, sync and play. Get started at phvalheim.com.
